title: Set Up an Ingress with Path‑Based Routing
description: Deploy two simple web apps and route them via an Ingress on different URL paths.
problemStatement:
## 🎯 Goal
Create an Ingress that routes `/app1` to one Service and `/app2` to another, all under the same host.

### Prerequisites
- An Ingress controller installed (minikube addons enable ingress).

### Steps
1. Create two Deployments: `app1` (image `hashicorp/http-echo`, args `-text="App1" -listen=:8080`) and `app2` (same image, args `-text="App2"`). Each with label `app: app1` and `app: app2`.
2. Expose each with a ClusterIP Service (`app1-svc`, port 80 → 8080) and (`app2-svc`, port 80 → 8080).
3. Apply both Deployments and Services.
4. Create an Ingress YAML `path-ingress.yaml`:
   - host: `demo.local` (or omit host for default)
   - two paths: `/app1` and `/app2`, both `pathType: Prefix`, pointing to the respective Services on port 80.
5. Apply the Ingress.
6. Edit your `/etc/hosts` (or use `curl -H "Host: demo.local"`) to map `demo.local` to the Ingress controller’s external IP (minikube ip).
7. Access `http://demo.local/app1` and `http://demo.local/app2` – you should see "App1" and "App2".
8. If using minikube, you can also run `minikube tunnel` and use the LoadBalancer IP.
9. Clean up.
hints: If you omit `host`, the Ingress applies to all HTTP traffic (default backend). But specifying a host is clearer.
Use `kubectl get ingress` to see the ADDRESS field populated after a few seconds.
The `hashicorp/http-echo` image is a simple server that prints a given text.
expectedOutput: Different responses for `/app1` and `/app2` from the same IP.
solutionCode:
# app1.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app1
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: app1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: app1
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: echo
        image: hashicorp/http-echo
        args: ["-text=App1", "-listen=:8080"]
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: app1-svc
spec:
  selector:
    app: app1
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 8080
---
# app2.yaml (similar, replace App1 with App2)
---
# path-ingress.yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: path-ingress
spec:
  rules:
  - host: demo.local
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /app1
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: app1-svc
            port:
              number: 80
      - path: /app2
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: app2-svc
            port:
              number: 80
